root_cause: Line 731 of test_parser.cpp writes `ov::util::make_path(m_base + u8"_\u6a21\u578b_\u017c\u00f3\u0142\u0107")`, concatenating a runtime `std::string` (`m_base`) with a `u8"..."` literal. Under the Build (C++20, non-blocking) job's `-DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=20` flag, `u8"..."` literals are typed as `const char8_t[]` (per C++20's P1423/char8_t rules) rather than `const char[]` as under C++17, so `std::string + const char8_t[]` no longer has a valid `operator+` overload and MSVC rejects the expression (C2676), which cascades into `make_path` overload resolution failure (C2672) and the subsequent uninitialized-const errors (C2737/C3536) for `unicode_prefix`. This file was newly added in commit 60d87a0f (#38986, merged earlier the same day) which introduced the C++20 non-blocking build lane itself, and the unicode-path test logic was not updated for char8_t string literal semantics, so the new lane immediately fails on its own test file. The PR under investigation (#39270) only modifies NPUW's `cut_lm_head.cpp/hpp` and its unit test, unrelated to the GGUF frontend, confirming the build break is pre-existing in `master` and surfaced by this merge-queue run rather than introduced by PR #39270.
reproduction_steps: Configure with `cmake -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=20 -DENABLE_TESTS=ON -DENABLE_OV_GGUF_FRONTEND=ON ...` on Windows/MSVC (or any C++20-mode compiler that types u8-literals as char8_t) and build target `ov_gguf_frontend_tests`; the failure reproduces at src/frontends/gguf/tests/test_parser.cpp:731 without needing the full CI pipeline.
recommended_actions: In src/frontends/gguf/tests/test_parser.cpp:731, change `m_base + u8"_\u6a21\u578b_\u017c\u00f3\u0142\u0107"` to concatenate compatible types, e.g. build the u8 literal into a `std::u8string`/`std::filesystem::path` first and append separately, or use a plain narrow string literal (drop the `u8` prefix) if the test only needs the characters as whatever encoding `m_base` already uses.

Alternatively wrap the right-hand side as `std::filesystem::path(u8"_\u6a21\u578b_\u017c\u00f3\u0142\u0107")` and concatenate paths instead of strings, since `ov::util::make_path` ultimately expects a path-convertible source.

Because this is the 'Build (C++20, non-blocking)' lane (introduced by #38986 on the same day), verify no other newly-added test files use similar `std::string + u8"..."` concatenation patterns that would break identically under C++20 char8_t semantics.
prevention_strategies: When adding new unicode-path test fixtures, avoid concatenating `std::string`/`const char*` with `u8"..."` literals directly; u8-literals became `char8_t`-typed in C++20, which silently breaks `operator+` overload resolution in codebases built under both C++17 and C++20. Build and smoke-test any new GGUF/unicode-path test code under the C++20 non-blocking lane (or locally with `-std=c++20`) before merging, especially right after that lane itself was introduced, since it has no prior history to catch this class of regression.
historical_context: No prior pattern for this signature exists in the knowledge base; this is a new failure first observed immediately after the 'Build (C++20, non-blocking)' lane was introduced by commit 60d87a0f (#38986) earlier the same day. The co-occurring TensorFlow Keras LSTM failure matches the well-known recurring pattern a284d27dfee44614 (6 prior occurrences since 2026-08-27, most recently 2026-11-04), an unrelated dropout-induced numerical-tolerance flake in the TF frontend layer tests.
